title: Guidance and Clarity
scripture: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
devotional: When facing uncertainty, step back and ask for guidance before reacting. Trusting God's direction brings peace to decision-making.
prayer: Holy Spirit, grant me wisdom today to see clearly and follow your leading in all my tasks.
actionStep: Take 5 minutes at midday to pause and commit your afternoon plans to prayer.
